blindMapping: spec-based audit, no live blind comparison
fixes: src/components/orders/bulk/order-job-modal.tsx (useEffect at ~L127-155): stop calling POST /api/ops/allocate when the modal mounts. Allocate only after the user clicks Create Job or Select Job, inside the same server transaction as job creation. If allocation must run up front, roll it back when the user clicks Cancel or X.

src/components/orders/bulk/order-job-modal.tsx (~L139-150): treat an order the allocator leaves in Shortage, or with allocatedQuantity < ordered, as failed. Add it to `fails` with the shortage message so the banner reads '0 of 1 order is allocated' and the FailureList names the short SKU. Never show 'allocated and ready' while the row is Shortage with 0 allocated.

Order code sequence (sequences.peek used by src/components/orders/wizard/step-details.tsx and /api/orders/code-check): skip codes that already exist. Loop the peek until code-check returns unique, or seed the sequence from MAX(code). The 'auto generated' regenerate link must return a new unique code, not the same SO010873.

src/components/orders/wizard/order-summary.tsx L32-33 and src/components/ui/progress-ring.tsx: the ring's centered percent label overlaps the absolutely positioned Truck icon, and the percent also repeats in the

beside it. Pass a prop that hides the inner label (e.g. showValue={false}) or remove the Truck overlay. Also compute percent as completed steps / 6 (0% at start, as in Logiwa), not 25% on first paint.

src/components/orders/detail/order-detail-page.tsx L88-95 and 169: while usePermissionSet() is still loading, render a skeleton or a neutral disabled Save (aria-busy) instead of the copy 'You don't have permission to edit shipment orders'. An Owner/admin with fulfillment.shipment_orders.edit currently sees that denial plus every field disabled until hydration finishes, 10-45s on this dev server.

src/components/orders/detail/order-detail-page.tsx and order-form-model.ts valuesFromDetail: the Order type select renders empty before hydration while the Summary card says 'D2C Order'. Seed the select's options from the server detail (detail.orderTypeName) so the SSR value is never blank.

src/components/orders/orders-list-page.tsx: render the page-header actions (Import, Create shipment order) and the bulk toolbar during the grid's loading state. Today they are absent until /api/orders resolves, 6-25s. Only the grid body should skeleton.

Server /api/orders?view=backlog (src/server/repositories/orders*.ts): 6.4s for 42 rows and 10s for /api/orders?view=shipped (413 rows), timed by fetch in the page. Profile the N+1 behind the per-row SKU/tags/job/customer joins; batch into single queries and add indexes on (status, warehouse_id, order_date). Also stop the duplicate request: each first load issues /api/orders, /options, /grid-prefs and /saved-views twice (first set ERR_ABORTED).

DataGrid (src/components/grid/data-grid.tsx): show an in-grid progress bar or dimmed rows while a refetch for a new filter, sort or search is in flight. Right now stale rows and the stale 'Total: 42' stay on screen for ~10s after Apply, with no busy indicator.

src/components/orders/wizard/step-details.tsx client combobox: show 'Loading clients...' with a spinner while options load. It currently shows 'No results' for ~5s after a warehouse is picked. Also stop clearing Order type when the warehouse or client changes (it reset from D2C Order to blank twice).

src/components/orders/wizard/step-products.tsx product-search-add: disable the + button and show a spinner per row while the add request is in flight, and debounce repeat clicks. The add takes 3-5s with no feedback, which produced an unintended qty 2 on APX-TEE-BLK-L. Show the ATP value in the search dropdown rows; it shows 'ATP —' there even though the added lines show 348/322.

Change log writer for order line creation (orders.createOrder in src/server/repositories/orders*.ts): each line's 'Quantity is modified. 0 --> N' entry is written twice (4:22:15 and 4:22:16). Write it once, using Logiwa's '<SKU> -> Shipment Order Line is created.' message. Also log address verification ('Address line 2 was merged into address line 1.') as a change-log entry.

Order detail rail (src/components/orders/detail/order-detail-rail.tsx): after a background status change (Open -> Ready to Pick, Job005279), the Summary still showed Open / 'No job assigned' / Last update 4:22:16 while the Activity feed on the same page already showed the job. Invalidate or poll the detail query together with the activity feed so the page never contradicts itself.

Gating in src/components/orders/bulk/order-eligibility.ts: Ship order is disabled for both Open and Ready to Pick orders, but Logiwa enables Ship Order for both. Create label is disabled for an Open order with no visible reason. Every disabled bulk menuitem needs a DisabledReason tooltip with the exact reason, e.g. 'No carrier service set on SO010873'.

Empty state (src/components/orders/orders-list-page.tsx): when the backlog has zero results, render the two Logiwa CTA cards below 'Could not find any shipment order': 'No products? Create products before creating a shipment order.' -> /products and 'OR You can create shipment orders here.' -> /orders/new. Only the text line renders today.

Dark-mode status pills (status-pill tokens used by src/lib/grid-defs/orders/shipment-orders.ts columns): Shortage (#F7E9E4/#A13406), Ready to Ship (#DFCEF5/#621DB8) and On Hold (#D7D9DD/#394357) keep light Logiwa backgrounds in dark mode. Ready to Pick is rgb(46,92,230) text on a 10% tint over the navy surface, which is under 3:1 contrast. Define --status-*-bg/-fg tokens per theme so every pill uses the same tinted dark treatment with >= 4.5:1 text contrast.

Shipped & Canceled grid: the cancelled order KS-E2E-SO-1 shows an Actual shipment date (11/06/2026 9:30 AM) equal to its cancel date. Leave shippedAt null for Cancelled orders. Let the default chip include cancellations by OR-ing cancelDate, or add a second 'Cancel date: Last 7 days' chip.
Create RMA (order-bulk-menus.tsx createRma): show a pending state on the button (spinner, disabled) during router.push. The navigation took ~15s with no feedback.

Copy: 'Add Note' (order detail NotesPanel), 'Custom Fields' / 'Create Custom Field' (step-other.tsx) and the 'Packing Slip (copy)' template label are Title Case or test junk. Use sentence case ('Add note', 'Custom fields', 'Create custom field') and rename or hide the duplicate packing-slip template. The return-address dropdown lists '1400 W Fulton Market, Chicago' twice; dedupe it or add the address name.
Order code column (src/components/orders/orders-columns.tsx): widen it to fit 16+ character codes, or add a title tooltip. KS-TEST-M01-SO-1 truncates to 'KS-TEST-M01-...'.
Accessibility: the tag chip buttons in the Tag popover and the two Billing address radios (step-customer.tsx) have no accessible names. Add aria-label or associated labels.
functional_failures: Opening a dialog mutates data: go to /orders, tick SO010873 (status Open), then Warehouse ops > Picking / job operations. The modal immediately POSTs /api/ops/allocate. Click Cancel. The order is now permanently 'Shortage' (GET /api/orders/SO010873 -> status Shortage, line alloc 0) even though no job was created.

Picking/job modal reports success incorrectly: in the same repro, the modal banner says '1 of 1 order is allocated and ready for a picking job' while the row behind it has just flipped to Shortage with 0 allocated.

The auto-generated order code collides: open /orders/new and click Next step with nothing filled. Order code is pre-filled 'SO010873' and shows 'Order code SO010873 already exists'. Clicking 'auto generated' (regenerate) returns the same SO010873. A user cannot create an order with the default code.

Pre-hydration permission denial: as admin@kitstak.io (role admin, userType Owner, /api/me lists fulfillment.shipment_orders.edit), open /orders/KS-TEST-M01-SO-1. For 10-45s the rail says 'You don't have permission to edit shipment orders', Save shipment order is disabled with that tooltip, all fields are disabled, and Order type is blank.

Grid chrome missing while loading: open /orders fresh. For 6-25s only skeleton rows render; the Import and Create shipment order header buttons and the Label / Warehouse ops / Print / Delete / Tag toolbar are absent and the page-size select is empty. The first visit in this run stayed on the skeleton indefinitely until a manual reload.

Backlog API latency: in the page, fetch('/api/orders?view=backlog') took 6.4s for 42 rows and fetch('/api/orders?view=shipped') took 10.0s. Applying the Status=Open filter kept stale rows and 'Total: 42' on screen ~10s with no busy indicator before showing Total 21.

Wizard client select shows a false empty state: on /orders/new pick Warehouse 'MLT1 - Main Fulfillment' and open Client right away. It shows 'No results' for ~5s, then the list appears. Order type also resets to blank after the warehouse or client changes.

Duplicate line add with no feedback: on wizard step 3, search 'APX-TEE-BLK' and press + on APX-TEE-BLK-L. There is no spinner or disabled state for 3-5s, so a second press adds again and the line becomes qty 2 ($72.00 total instead of $48.00). The search dropdown shows 'ATP —' for every result.

Change log duplicates: create KS-TEST-M01-SO-1 with 2 lines, then Show change log. Each line has two identical entries, 'APX-TEE-BLK-L -> Quantity is modified. 0 --> 2', at 4:22:15 and 4:22:16. There is no 'Shipment Order Line is created' entry and no address-normalization entry.

The detail page contradicts itself: after the order was moved to Ready to Pick / Job005279 at 4:24:41, the open detail page's Summary still read 'Open', 'No job assigned', 'Last update 4:22:16' while its Activity feed listed 'Status is modified. Open --> Ready to Pick'. Saving then returned PATCH 409; the conflict banner only fixed it after Reload.

Ship order is never enabled: tick an Open order (SO010873) or open Other actions on the Ready to Pick order KS-TEST-M01-SO-1. Ship order is disabled with no reason shown. Create label is disabled with no reason for the Open order.

Backlog empty state is incomplete: open /orders?q=ZZZNOPE. Only 'Could not find any shipment order / Try changing the filters or search term' renders; the two CTA cards required by the spec and checklist are missing.

Cancelled order shows a ship date: open /orders/shipped (default chip Actual shipment date Last 7 days). Cancelled row KS-E2E-SO-1 shows Actual shipment date 11/06/2026 9:30 AM, identical to its Cancel date.

Create RMA has no feedback: on /orders/shipped tick SO010848 (Shipped) and click Create RMA. Nothing visible happens for ~10-15s, then it navigates to /orders/returns/new?orderIds=... The button shows no pending state.

Dark-mode contrast: with the dark color scheme, open /orders. The 'Ready to Pick' pill is rgb(46,92,230) text on a 10% blue tint over the navy surface, under 3:1 contrast. Shortage, Ready to Ship and On Hold pills keep light Logiwa backgrounds (#F7E9E4, #DFCEF5, #D7D9DD) and read as light-only surfaces.

Progress ring overlap: on /orders/new the Order status ring draws its '25%' label on top of the truck icon, and '25%' repeats beside it. It shows 25% before any field is filled, 75% at step 3 with no products, and 100% with the label overlapping the icon on the detail page.
Tags column is not sortable: on /orders the TAGS header has no sort button, while every other column header has 'Click to sort'.
logiwa_wins: Per spec, Logiwa's Ship Order is enabled for Open and Ready to Pick orders, with a confirm table. KitStaks disables Ship order for both and gives no reason.
Per spec, Logiwa's Create Job wizard allocates only as part of creating or merging the job. KitStaks allocates as soon as the modal opens, mutates status on Cancel, and reports false success.
Per spec, Logiwa auto-fills the next unique order code (e.g. SO0008) with a working regenerate link. KitStaks pre-fills a code that already exists and regenerate returns the same code.
Per spec, Logiwa's empty state has the two CTA cards ('No products? Create products...' and 'OR You can create shipment orders here'). KitStaks shows only the text line.
Per spec, Logiwa's progress ring is a clean 0-100% (20% per step) with a truck icon. KitStaks overlaps the percent text with the icon, duplicates it, and starts at 25%.

Per spec, Logiwa's change log writes '<SKU> -> Shipment Order Line is created.' once per line and logs address-verification notes. KitStaks double-writes quantity entries and omits the line-created and verification entries.
Per spec, Logiwa's product search rows show live availability. KitStaks' search dropdown shows 'ATP —' for every SKU.
Per spec, Logiwa's Shipped & Canceled tab shows CANCEL DATE separately from ACTUAL SHIPMENT DATE. KitStaks fills Actual shipment date on cancelled orders.
Per spec, Logiwa's status pills use one consistent palette. KitStaks mixes light Logiwa pill backgrounds with themed translucent pills in dark mode, and Ready to Pick fails contrast.
Per spec, Logiwa's header actions and toolbar render immediately with the grid. KitStaks hides Import, Create and the bulk toolbar until the 6-25s data fetch finishes.
